newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 5-mth car sales down 5.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 5-mth car sales down 5.8 pct.

text.p: Philippine car sales fell 5.8 percent in the first five months to 33,912 units from 35,995 a year earlier, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers Inc of the Philippines reported on Tuesday.
Car sales reached 6,603 units in May alone, up from the previous month's level of 6,318 units but down from the year-ago level of 7,357 units.
The industry group said the overall slowdown in sales could have been brought about as banks and financial institutions continued to be stricter about approving car loans.

Prospective buyers may also be waiting for the introduction of new models and there could have been a buying switch to commercial vehicles such as vans and pick-ups which had an increase of sales of 859 units in May, the group said.

In the January to May period, car sales were led by the unit of Japan's Honda Motor Co Ltd with 6,614 units, followed by the units of Toyota Motor Co, 6,274; Mitsubishi Motors Corp, 6,097; and Nissan Motor Co Ltd, 4,569.
